fact: Late attendance of the Thursday Press Conference.
offence: Breach of Article 19.1 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards received a report from the Media Delegate that the driver of Car 1 (Max Verstappen), was late for the Thursday Press Conference. The Media Delegate reported that the driver had some transportation issues on the way to the track, but the team informed the FIA in advance. The Stewards conclude that the driver and the team took every reasonable measure given the circumstances and therefore impose no penalty despite technically the regulations have been breached.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 1 Media Commitment
to: The Team Manager, Oracle Red Bull Racing
